segments.name: Life Sciences
segments.description: Makes excipients and additives for drug formulations and other life science uses.
segments.evidence: Ashland's reportable operating segments ("reportable segments") include: Life Sciences; Personal Care; Specialty Additives; and Intermediates.

segments.name: Personal Care
segments.description: Supplies polymers and ingredients to hair care and personal care formulators.
segments.evidence: The Personal Care portfolio of hair care products includes advanced styling polymers, fixatives, conditioning polymers, emulsifiers, preservatives, rheology modifiers and biofunctional actives.

segments.name: Specialty Additives
segments.description: Makes thickeners and additives for paints, coatings and industrial applications.
segments.evidence: Products include hydroxyethylcellulose ("HEC"), which provides thickening and application properties for interior and exterior paints, and nonionic synthetic associative thickeners ("NSATs"), which are APEO-free liquid synthetics for high-performance paint and industrial coatings.

segments.name: Intermediates
segments.description: Produces chemical intermediates, including BDO, for internal use and external sale.
segments.evidence: BDO is also supplied to Life Sciences, Personal Care, and Specialty Additives reportable segments for use as a raw material.

revenueModel.text: Consumer, industrial, pharmaceutical and food manufacturers buy its specialty chemicals.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company serves customers in a wide range of consumer and industrial markets including, architectural coatings, construction, energy, food and beverage, personal care and pharmaceutical.
